name: Quotel Hotel Booking – Hotel Reservation & Booking Calendar with AI
author: Syed Tarikul Islam

sections.description:
Quotel Hotel Booking turns your WordPress site into a direct booking engine. Guests search dates, pick a room, pay online and get a confirmation email. You manage rooms, prices, availability and reservations from one modern dashboard. No commission, no monthly fee.

It is built for hotels, resorts, B&Bs, guest houses, hostels, homestays, villas and vacation rentals of any size, from a single room to many room types with several units each.

Everything you need to take bookings is free: rooms, booking calendar, seasonal pricing, Stripe and PayPal payments, deposits, coupons, emails, reports and the AI Booking Concierge.

Why hotel owners choose Quotel

  • Take direct bookings, keep the commission. A fast, mobile-friendly booking form your guests can finish in under a minute.
  • Get paid online for free. Stripe (cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay) and PayPal are built in. No WooCommerce needed.
  • Never double-book. Live availability checks, multiple units per room type, and unpaid bookings are released automatically.
  • Answer guests 24/7 with AI. An optional AI chat assistant checks live availability and sends guests to checkout with their dates filled in.
  • Set up in minutes. A setup wizard (with an optional AI assistant) creates your rooms and rules, and booking pages are added for you.

Booking engine and booking calendar

  • Multi-step hotel booking form: search dates → choose room → guest details → summary → payment.
  • Booking bar for your home page hero with check-in / check-out date pickers and guest counters.
  • Room search grid with filters, room galleries and a “Book now” button on every room page.
  • Booking calendar for staff with month and timeline views, room filter and per-day management.
  • Close dates, override nightly prices and set multiple units per room type.
  • Instant booking or request mode (you approve each booking before the guest pays).
  • Manual bookings for phone, walk-in and email reservations, plus a guest check-in screen.
  • Guest bookings with or without an account, and a My Bookings page for logged-in guests.

Rates, pricing and payments

  • Base and weekend rates per room, seasonal / date-range pricing rules.
  • Long-stay discounts (weekly / monthly), tax (inclusive or exclusive) and coupons.
  • Stripe Checkout and PayPal built in. Payments are verified with the gateway before a booking is confirmed.
  • Deposits: charge a percentage or fixed amount online and collect the rest at the hotel.
  • Or take bookings with pay at hotel / bank transfer.
  • Unpaid online bookings are released after a hold time you choose, so abandoned checkouts never block rooms.

AI built in (optional)

Connect your own key for OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini or OpenRouter, or use the AI connectors in WordPress 7. AI stays off until you turn it on.

  • AI Booking Concierge: a chat assistant for your website. It answers questions about rooms, prices and policies, checks live availability for the guest’s dates and shows “Book this room” buttons. Prices always come from Quotel, never from the AI. Free: 50 conversations a month.
  • AI content writer: write room descriptions, short summaries, amenity lists, SEO titles, meta descriptions and FAQs from the room editor. Works with Yoast SEO and Rank Math.
  • AI setup assistant: describe your property in a few sentences and AI drafts your rooms, rates and policies for you to review.
  • Ready for AI agents: through the WordPress Abilities API, AI assistants and MCP clients can list rooms, check availability, get quotes and (if you allow it) create bookings.

Guest emails and notifications

  • Booking confirmation, pending payment (with pay link), cancellation and check-in reminder emails.
  • Editable email subjects and messages with placeholders such as {guest_name}, {booking_id} and {check_in}.
  • Optional SMS confirmations through Twilio.
  • iCal feed of your bookings to subscribe from Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook.

Reports and management

  • Dashboard with bookings, revenue, occupancy and upcoming arrivals.
  • Revenue, occupancy, room performance and guest reports with CSV export.
  • Booking list with status filters, search, approve / decline and payment details.
  • Custom manage_hotel_bookings capability for your staff.

Works with your theme and page builder

Add booking pages with shortcodes in the block editor, Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder or any theme. The AI Booking Concierge also has its own block.

  • [qhb_booking_form] – the full booking form (auto-created Book a Room page).
  • [qhb_booking_bar] – compact search bar for hero sections. Attributes: redirect="https://example.com/book/", button="Check availability".
  • [qhb_room_search] – room search with filters and results grid.
  • [qhb_my_bookings] – the logged-in guest’s bookings.
  • [qhb_ai_concierge] – the AI chat assistant inline on a page.

Free and Pro

The free plugin is a complete hotel reservation system. Quotel Hotel Booking Pro adds:

  • WooCommerce checkout with any WooCommerce payment gateway, room → product sync and order-status booking lifecycle.
  • Daily booking digest email and priority updates.

Pro pricing: $49 / 1 year, $69 / 3 years, $150 lifetime.

For developers

  • REST API under qhb/v1 (rooms, bookings, availability, pricing, calendar, reports).
  • Custom post type qhb_room (slug rooms) with qhb_room_type and qhb_amenity taxonomies.
  • Filters such as qhb_booking_spam_check, qhb_pending_hold_minutes, qhb_client_ip and qhb_ai_pre_generate.
  • Translation-ready (text domain quotel-hotel-booking, .pot file included).

Privacy

Quotel stores the booking details you collect from guests (name, email, phone, address, ID details if you ask for them, dates, party size and notes) in your WordPress database. Emails are sent with WordPress’s wp_mail(). Mention this in your site’s privacy policy.

The plugin sends no data to outside services unless you turn on one of the features below.

External services

Stripe – only if you choose Stripe under Settings → Payment. When a guest pays, the booking amount, currency, room name, stay dates, booking reference and guest email are sent to Stripe (api.stripe.com) to create the payment page, and Quotel then asks Stripe whether the payment succeeded. Terms · Privacy Policy

PayPal – only if you choose PayPal under Settings → Payment. When a guest pays, the booking amount, currency, room name, stay dates and booking reference are sent to PayPal (api-m.paypal.com, or api-m.sandbox.paypal.com in sandbox mode) to create and capture the payment. User Agreement · Privacy Statement

AI providers – only if you turn on AI under Hotel Booking → AI. Guest chat messages, your room details (names, prices, capacity, amenities, descriptions), live availability results and the hotel notes you enter are sent to the provider you choose:

  • OpenAI (api.openai.com) – Terms · Privacy
  • Anthropic (api.anthropic.com) – Terms · Privacy
  • Google Gemini (generativelanguage.googleapis.com) – Terms · Privacy
  • OpenRouter (openrouter.ai) – Terms · Privacy
  • “WordPress AI” uses the service your site’s WordPress AI connectors are set up with.

Twilio – only if you turn on SMS under Settings → Advanced. The guest’s phone number and the confirmation text are sent to Twilio (api.twilio.com). Terms · Privacy

Quotel license server – only if you enter a Pro license key under Hotel Booking → License. The license key, your site’s domain and the product name are sent to queuecommerce.com when you activate the key and once a day to check it. queuecommerce.com
sections.installation:
1. In your dashboard go to Plugins → Add New, search for Quotel Hotel Booking, then click Install Now and Activate.
  2. Follow the setup wizard at Hotel Booking → Welcome. You can describe your property and let AI draft your rooms, or skip that step.
  3. Add or edit rooms under Hotel Rooms: price, weekend price, capacity, units, photos and amenities.
  4. Choose how guests pay under Hotel Booking → Settings → Payment (Stripe, PayPal or pay at hotel).
  5. The Book a Room page with [qhb_booking_form] is created for you. Add [qhb_booking_bar] to your home page.
  6. Optional: turn on the AI Booking Concierge under Hotel Booking → AI.

If room pages show a 404 error, go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save.
sections.faq:
Is this hotel booking plugin free?

Yes. Rooms, bookings, the booking calendar, pricing rules, Stripe and PayPal payments, deposits, coupons, emails, reports and the AI features are free. Pro adds WooCommerce checkout and a few extras.

Can I accept online payments?

Yes. Choose Stripe or PayPal under Settings → Payment and add your API keys. Guests pay on the secure Stripe or PayPal page and the booking is confirmed automatically. You can also take a deposit online and collect the rest at check-in.

Do I need WooCommerce?

No. Payments with Stripe and PayPal work without WooCommerce. WooCommerce is only needed if you want other WooCommerce payment gateways (Pro).

Can I use it for a B&B, guest house or vacation rental?

Yes. Each room type can have one or many units, so it works for a single villa, a small B&B or a hotel with many rooms.

Can I set seasonal prices and weekend rates?

Yes. Every room has a base and a weekend price. Add date-range pricing rules for seasons and holidays, override single days in the calendar and offer weekly or monthly discounts.

How does the AI Booking Concierge work? Does it cost money?

The concierge reads your rooms, prices, policies and live availability and answers guests in their own language. It uses your own AI provider key (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini or OpenRouter), so you pay the provider directly, usually a fraction of a cent per message. The free version includes 50 guest conversations a month.

Can the AI make up prices or book rooms on its own?

No. Availability and prices are calculated by Quotel and only shown to the guest with a “Book this room” button. The guest completes the booking in the normal booking form.

How do I stop double bookings?

Quotel checks availability live for every night of a stay and locks the room while a booking is saved, so two guests cannot take the last unit at once. Unpaid online bookings are released after the hold time you set.

Does it sync with Booking.com or Airbnb?

Quotel provides an iCal feed of your bookings that you can subscribe to from calendar apps. Two-way channel sync with booking sites is not included yet.

Does it work with Elementor and the block editor?

Yes. Place the shortcodes in any page builder or theme. The AI Booking Concierge is also available as a block.

Can I translate the plugin?

Yes. It is translation-ready and includes a .pot file. Use Loco Translate, Poedit, WPML or Polylang.

Is guest booking without an account supported?

Yes. Turn it on or off under Settings → Booking, and optionally require a phone number.

Does uninstalling delete my bookings?

No. Deactivating or deleting the plugin keeps your bookings and settings in the database.
sections.changelog:
1.6.0

  • New: free Stripe and PayPal payments without WooCommerce, verified with the gateway before a booking is confirmed.
  • New: signature-verified Stripe webhook confirms bookings even if the guest closes the browser.
  • New: online deposits through Stripe and PayPal.
  • New: payment status, amount paid and transaction ID on each booking.
  • New: AI Booking Concierge chat assistant (floating bubble, [qhb_ai_concierge] shortcode or block) with live availability and booking links.
  • New: AI content writer in the room editor (description, summary, amenities, SEO title and meta, FAQ).
  • New: AI setup assistant in the setup wizard.
  • New: WordPress Abilities API support (list rooms, check availability, get quote, create booking).
  • New: Hotel Booking → AI page with connection test and guest conversation logs.
  • Improved: New Booking page matches the other admin screens.
  • New: one-click demo hotel import (rooms with photos and prices, pages, posts) under Hotel Booking → Welcome, with one-click removal.
  • New: [qhb_room_details] shortcode. Themes that declare quotel-hotel-booking support (like the free Quotel theme) can use their own room page template.
  • Fix: room search no longer hides rooms without a maximum guest count.

1.5.1

  • Fix: unpaid online bookings expire after a configurable hold time (default 60 minutes).
  • Fix: per-room booking lock prevents double bookings of the last unit.
  • Fix: approving or confirming a request re-checks availability.
  • Security: rate limit and honeypot on the public booking endpoint; qhb_booking_spam_check filter for CAPTCHA add-ons.
  • Fix: guest bookings are validated (published room, future dates, valid email, room capacity).
  • Performance: faster availability check.
  • Fix: database tables upgrade correctly on plugin update.
  • Added translation template (languages/quotel-hotel-booking.pot).

1.5.0

  • Tested with WordPress 7.1.

1.4.0

  • All booking features are free; Pro covers WooCommerce checkout.
  • Removed demo / preview data.

1.3.1

  • New: deposits, coupon codes and request (approval) booking mode.
  • New: custom email templates, check-in reminders and From name / address.
  • New: Twilio SMS and iCal feed.
  • Improved: server-side minimum / maximum nights.

1.3.0

  • Fix: admin margins on WordPress 7.

1.2.0

  • Improved: License page rebuilt in React.

1.1.0

  • New: [qhb_booking_bar] shortcode.
  • Rebrand from hbm_ to qhb_ with a one-time migration. Old shortcodes and REST routes still work.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
